allow: PowerShell($p = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique; foreach \($id in $p\) { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "still listening" } else { "port 3000 free" })
